newsitem.title: MADAGASCAR: One killed, one injured in Madagascar campaign.
newsitem.headline: One killed, one injured in Madagascar campaign.

text.p: Unidentified attackers have killed a supporter of a presidential candidate and seriously injured another in violence ahead of the November 3 poll, party officials said on Thursday.
They said the supporter of National Assembly President Pastor Richard Andriamanjato was killed and another was still in a coma after attacks on Tuesday and Wednesday in the run-up to the election.
A spokesman for Andriamanjato's party accused supporters of former president Albert Zafy, who is also a candidate, of causing trouble at a rally at Antsiranana in northern Madagascar.
Fifteen candidates are standing for the presidency including Zafy, whose impeachment by parliament in July cleared the way for the election, and former president Didier Ratsiraka.
Retired admiral Ratsiraka, 59, and the father of Madagascar's 1975 socialist revolution, returned to his homeland for the race on September 29, ending 19 months of voluntary exile in France.
Zafy, 70, won Madagascar's multi-party elections in 1993 by defeating former military ruler Ratsiraka, ending his 17 years in power, after an unprecedented campaign of popular protest at his rule.
But Zafy's presidency was dogged by instability, culminating in his impeachment by parliament for violating the constitution.
